title: QUIZ - 99
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Apply the logical AND operator to a two-condition access control scenario
questions.question: A program grants access only if the user's score is at least 77 AND the user's attempts remaining is at least 3. A user has a score of 74 and 8 attempts remaining. Is access granted?

options.label: D
options.text: This cannot be determined from the given information.

questions.explanation: Score condition: \(74 \geq 77\) is False. Attempts condition: \(8 \geq 3\) is True. Since AND requires both to be true, and the result is False, access is denied.
questions.hint: Check both conditions separately; both must be true for the AND condition to grant access.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the truth value of a compound AND statement given the truth values of its parts
questions.question: Statement P: "12 is divisible by 5." (false). Statement Q: "8 is a prime number." (false). What is the truth value of "P AND Q"?
questions.explanation: AND is true only when both statements are true. Here P is false and Q is false, so P AND Q is false.
questions.hint: 'AND' is true only when both parts are true; if either part is false, the whole AND statement is false.

questions.learningObjective: Recall the condition under which a compound AND statement is true
questions.question: For a statement combining two conditions with AND, when is the result true?

options.label: A
options.text: When both P and Q are false.

options.label: B
options.text: Only when both P and Q are true.

options.label: C
options.text: When at least one of P or Q is true.

options.label: D
options.text: Whenever P is true, regardless of Q.

questions.explanation: The logical AND (conjunction) is true only in the single case where both individual statements are true; it is false in every other case.
questions.hint: AND requires both conditions to hold; a single false condition makes the whole AND statement false.
